gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.10cd26cbac242280.en: Epoxy Resin is a polymer compound characterized by epoxide groups (-O-). It is typically a high-performance thermosetting plastic formed by reacting epoxide monomers with a curing agent. Epoxy Resin features excellent mechanical properties, electrical insulation, chemical stability, and adhesiveness, and is widely used in coatings, adhesives, electronic packaging, structural reinforcement, and composite materials.

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.41201c74cc5f7b90.zh: 如果放入模拟卡不工作，请拆掉主机再放回去

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.4cdcf542f45205eb.zh: 有并行的化学反应釜，还能通过升级线圈从而提高效率

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.en: At this stage, you can go straight for the Large version
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.zh: 这个时候你也可以直接做大的

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.en: In fact, Filter Casings in multiblock structures only need to be the lowest tier; there is no need to upgrade them
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.zh: 实际上多方块结构中的过滤器机械方块可以只使用最低级的，没有必要升级

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.en: Besides getting Sponges from Elder Guardians, you can also craft them using Polycaprolactam
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.503c03c654730f65.zh: 除了去找远古守卫者要，你还可以用聚己内酰胺做海绵

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.zh: 为设备运行提供算力，更多的算力需要升级组件或者使用交换机合并多个计算机算力

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.en: Coolant required by active cooling components is supplied through an Input Hatch
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.zh: 主动冷却组件所需的冷却液通过输入仓供给

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.en: If the HPCA overheats, random components will be damaged (turning into their corresponding casings) and it will stop working
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.zh: 若HPCA过热，会有随机的组件损坏（变成对应外壳）然后停止工作

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.zh: &e电力输入不足&r或&e没有算力需求&r时HPCA不会工作

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.zh: &4&l请注意区分算力数据仓（传输算力）和光学数据仓（传输数据）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.50fffb0ebedae50b.en: Computation Data Reception/Transmission Hatches &ccannot&r be shared

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52980d117ab477b2.zh: 只能采集主世界的六种流体和熔岩

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.52df531afb3a07ce.zh: 先靠聚变出的液态铕固化获得，后面可以用电力高炉直接烧制

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.536de86ad2109f58.zh: 先用&d闪存&r右键样板总成，然后右键镜像将镜像绑定至先前的样板总成

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.536de86ad2109f58.zh: 镜像会显示绑定的样板总成的坐标

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.536de86ad2109f58.en: Right-clicking the Proxy lets you interact directly with the bound ME Pattern Buffer
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.536de86ad2109f58.zh: 右键镜像能直接与绑定的样板总成互动

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53dee1a65051e06f.en: Don't go looking for the ore; &bdecay&r &6Radium
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53dee1a65051e06f.zh: 不要去找矿石，去&b衰变&r&6镭

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53eb6e99f976af31.zh: 输入总线&e&l必须&r放入一个机器人作为&o&c催化剂&r使用，机器人等级越高配方耗时越短，此处机器人数量不影响并行

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53eb6e99f976af31.zh: 在主机放入与输入总线中相同的机器人可获得更高的并行数，最多64个机器人（128并行）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53eb6e99f976af31.zh: 不同于装配线，电路装配线可以使用&bULV巨型输入总线&r以及&bEV巨型输入仓&r，但是&c不能使用样板总成&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53eb6e99f976af31.en: Really not a multiblock Circuit Assembler!
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.53eb6e99f976af31.zh: 真不是什么多方块电路组装机！

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: Simply put, it lets machines use items directly from the ME Network
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 简单来说就是让机器直接从ME网络拿物品来用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: Left-click with a &dData Stick&r to save hatch settings, and Right-Click to apply them
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 用&d闪存&r左键保存仓室配置，右键应用配置

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 可以开启&6自动拉取模式&r，自动拉取网络中的库存物品/流体（&b标签总线可设置拉取排序模式&r）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: Right-click an ME hatch with &dWire Cutters&r to toggle between connecting to the ME Network only from the front face or from any face
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 用&d剪线钳&r右键ME仓室可以让ME仓室在从正面联网和从任意面联网之间切换

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 可在仓室gui左下角调整&6拉取间隔&r，默认显示0tick为不改变拉取间隔，&b最低1tick&r（影响从ME网络拉取的速度）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: You can enable &dExtreme Pull Mode&r in the gtlcore config file so that &6ME Stocking Dual Input Hatches&r pull without delay (affecting parallelism calculation), though this may impact TPS
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 可在gtlcore的配置文件中开启&d极限拉取模式&r，让&6ME库存输入总成&r拉取不再有延迟（影响并行计算），但可能会对TPS有一定的影响

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: Tag Stocking Buses/Hatches are used in the same way as Tag Storage Buses
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 标签库存总线/仓使用方式与标签存储总线相同

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.en: Note: 1. Because AE needs to rebuild the network when loading a world, stocking hatches will briefly disconnect and fail to supply inputs to machines
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 注意：1.由于在进入存档时AE需要重新组网，库存仓室会在一段很短的时间内断网进而导致无法使机器获得输入

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5608182772e855ec.zh: 2.在同一个多方块结构中的多个库存输入仓/总线不能标记相同的内容物

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5744f6172d4e112b.en: Can serve as a transitional Steam production machine before the Fission Reactor
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5744f6172d4e112b.zh: 可以作为裂变堆之前的过渡蒸汽生产机器

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5744f6172d4e112b.en: Compressed Diamond Blocks are Burn Time King #2
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5744f6172d4e112b.zh: 压缩钻石块是耐烧王二号

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.585580afdfacddb8.zh: 0.2x用于加速机器，1.2x用于节省燃料，某些情况可以使发电机获得额外超频次数进而增加发电功率

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.585580afdfacddb8.zh: 默认以0.01的倍率调整，按住shift为0.1，按住ctrl为1

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.585580afdfacddb8.zh: 配置复制工具可以复制黏贴处理耗时设置

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.585580afdfacddb8.en: You can also craft the &6Configurable Cleaning Maintenance Hatch&r now
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.585580afdfacddb8.zh: 你同时可以制作&6可配置超净维护仓&r了

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b01312e34a3ad60.en: Using higher-tier superconductor wires reduces the consumption of Niobium-Titanium and Trinium
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b01312e34a3ad60.zh: 使用高级超导线缆可以减少铌钛合金和凯金的消耗量

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b73961795be42ee.zh: 艾萨线，这是一条新的矿物处理线，效率一般，但是在后期必须使用。

Grindballs must be placed inside the multiblock controller and wear out quickly; restock them using an ME Export Bus (from AE2) or a Robot Arm + ME Interface
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b73961795be42ee.zh: 研磨球需要放入多方块主机，且很容易损耗，可用ME输出总线（AE那个）或者机械臂+ME接口等方式补充

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b73961795be42ee.en: Alumina Grindballs have 100 durability, and Soapstone Grindballs have 50 durability (applying Unbreaking does nothing; Mending takes effect &mbut is equally useless&r)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5b73961795be42ee.zh: 铝研磨球耐久值100，皂石研磨球耐久50（耐久附魔敲上去没用，经验修补可以生效&m但其实也没用&r）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5bb55aabb91eef9d.en: Uses an extremely high direct energy flow to perform calculations similar to electronic circuits.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5bb55aabb91eef9d.zh: 使用极高的直接能量流来进行类似电子电路的计算。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5c4b11cea53d5b78.en: Can only be placed inside a &bData Access Hatch&r of a &6formed Data Bank&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5c4b11cea53d5b78.zh: 只能放入&6成型的数据库&r的&b数据访问仓&r中

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.en: Packaging common circuits into Universal Circuits is recommended to make modifying patterns easier later on
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.zh: 推荐把各种常用电路打包为通用电路板，方便以后修改样板

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.en: When encoding patterns, &bUniversal Circuits&r will be &6prioritized&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.zh: 在编写样板时会&6优先&r将&b通用电路板&r写入样板

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.en: Due to AE's NBT recognition issues, &4do not enable substitutions&r on &acrafting patterns&r that use &6Universal Circuits&r as ingredients, or crafting jobs may stall
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5cc41e8e3f814de9.zh: 由于AE的NBT识别问题，合成材料中带有&6通用电路板&r的&a合成样板&r&4不要开启可替换模式&r，否则会出现卡合成的问题

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5ccd191a904b528a.en: A very handy Void Miner with high efficiency, though it requires setting up a Gem Slurry line; it drastically cuts down your mining time (though with Ultimine, mining doesn't take long anyway)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5ccd191a904b528a.zh: 非常好用的虚采，效率很高，但是需要做宝石浆液产线，可以大幅减少你下矿的时间（有超级连锁其实下矿时间不多）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5ccd191a904b528a.en: You can put it off until the next voltage tier or even later
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5ccd191a904b528a.zh: 你可以拖到下个电压甚至更后面

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5d4131c48f9bae46.zh: 在后面的阶段还会有用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e7f20c5f8530e1e.en: Uses a micro-ecosystem to simulate calculations and synthesize solutions, serving as a high-speed, high-throughput computing device.
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e7f20c5f8530e1e.zh: 它使用微型生态系统模拟计算，并将结果转化为综合解决方案。是高速、高吞吐量的计算设备。

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.en: A single computer may not provide enough computation; to combine computation from multiple computers, you must use this machine
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.zh: 一台计算机提供的算力可能不够，如果要合并算力就必须使用这台机器

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.en: Make sure an &b&lHPCA Bridge Component is installed in each computer before use
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.zh: 在使用前确保计算机上安装了&b&l桥接组件

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.en: The computation shown in the Network Switch GUI is only the sum of the theoretical maximum computation of all connected computers, &c&lnot the actual computation&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.zh: 交换机界面显示的算力只是所有连接的计算机理论最大算力的总和，&c&l不是实际算力&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.en: While the Network Switch is operating normally, each computation hatch continuously consumes &e7,680&r EU/t (0.9375A &9IV&r); &4if power is insufficient, some computation hatches will stop working
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.zh: 网络交换机正常运行时，每一个算力仓都会持续耗能&e 7,680 &rEU/t（0.9375A &9IV&r)，&4如果供电不足则有部分算力仓失效

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.en: Network Switches can be daisy-chained (a Network Switch can accept computation from other Network Switches)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e86110bbaea92ba.zh: 交换机间可以串联（交换机可以接受其他交换机的算力）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e9e2f25ae1ec731.en: You can craft the HPCA Bridge Component now, though you probably won't need it at this stage
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5e9e2f25ae1ec731.zh: 你可以制作计算机的桥接组件了，不过这个阶段你可能也用不上它

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: High-capacity data storage that supplies data to multiple Assembly Lines using Optical Data Hatches
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 大容量数据存储，使用光学数据仓室为多个装配线提供数据

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: Data Banks can also be daisy-chained (a Data Bank can receive data from another Data Bank via an Optical Data Reception Hatch)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 数据库间还可以串联（数据库可以通过靶仓获得来自其他数据库的数据）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: Optical Data Reception/Transmission Hatches &ccannot&r be shared
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 光学数据靶/源仓&c并不能&r共用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: Wired optical hatches transmit data via Optical Pipes, and Optical Pipes &ecannot branch&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 有线光学仓间使用光缆传递数据，且光缆&e不能分叉&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: Wireless optical hatches are bound using a &dData Stick&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 无线光学仓间使用&d闪存&r进行绑定

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: Every hatch (both Optical and Data Access) continuously consumes &e1,920&r EU/t (0.9375A &5EV&r)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 每一个仓室（光学和访问）都会持续耗能 &e1,920&r EU/t（0.9375A &5EV&r）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: If the Data Bank is being written to or read from by other machines, the power consumption of each hatch increases to &e30,720&r EU/t (0.9375A &dLuV&r)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: 若数据库正在被其他机器写入或读取数据，则每个仓室的耗能功率均提升至 &e30,720&r EU/t（0.9375A &dLuV&r)

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.en: &4If power is insufficient, some hatches will stop working
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.5f0a175d6704a8d0.zh: &4如果供电不足则有部分仓室失效

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.61838e13426b2b88.en: Input oil and Steam, output products
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.61838e13426b2b88.zh: 输入油和蒸汽，输出产物

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.61838e13426b2b88.en: The Petrochemical Plant does not produce intermediate products; you can either keep your old petrochemical line or extract intermediates directly with the Space Elevator later
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.61838e13426b2b88.zh: 石化工厂不会产出中间产物，你可以选择保留旧有石化产线或者到后面用太空电梯直接采集中间产物

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.62b67704211a105d.en: High Speed Steel (HSS) is a more wear-resistant steel alloy
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.62b67704211a105d.zh: 高速钢(HSS)是更耐磨的钢合金

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.631707e722744406.en: You can assemble it from Wither Skeleton Skulls and Soul Sand (before going to the Nether, you can find some Soul Sand in an Ancient City)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.631707e722744406.zh: 你可以用凋零骷髅头和灵魂沙组装（没去下界之前去坚守者老家找几个灵魂沙）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.631707e722744406.en: However, you'll mainly rely on Lightning Processing + Implosion
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.631707e722744406.zh: 不过主要还是得靠闪电处理-聚爆

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.650980ab3d2a6af6.en: Produces the corresponding gas via data simulation rather than absorbing gas from the dimension
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.650980ab3d2a6af6.zh: 通过数据模拟制造对应的气体而不是吸收维度中的气体

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.650980ab3d2a6af6.en: You can also place a Vacuum Freezer into its Input Bus / Dual Input Hatch to obtain Liquid Air directly
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.650980ab3d2a6af6.zh: 还可以在输入总线/成放入真空冷冻机直接获得液态空气

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.66ae53e13e3c3c19.en: Calorite can be mined on Mercury
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.66ae53e13e3c3c19.zh: 耐热金属在水星能挖到

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.66ae53e13e3c3c19.en: Also used later to craft Netherite Ingots
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.66ae53e13e3c3c19.zh: 后期还要用来制作下界合金锭

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: The relationship between an ME Pattern Buffer and other hatches is &calways&r &bcompletely distinct
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 样板总成本身与其他仓室的关系&c始终为&r&b完全隔离

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: When encoding a pattern, click the up-arrow button to the right of the encode arrow after encoding, or click the upload button directly (which auto-encodes even if not yet encoded), to upload the pattern into an &dME Pattern Buffer&r or &dMolecular Manipulator Hatch&r of the corresponding machine mode (Note: pressing encode a second time clears the pattern's machine mode, preventing upload). Full Pattern Buffers will not appear in the upload list. If multiple Pattern Buffers share the exact same name, the upload list merges them into a single button (without coordinates)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 在编码样板时，编码完成之后点击编码箭头右侧的向上箭头按钮，或者直接点击上传按钮（此时即使未编码也会自动编码）可将样板上传到对应机器模式的&d样板总成&r或者&d分子操纵者端口&r里（注意：多按一次编码会导致样板的机器模式消失从而无法上传）。样板总成已满后不会在上传界面中显示。如果有多个名字一模一样的样板总成，上传界面会将这几个样板总成合并成一个按钮（不会显示坐标）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: "Recipe Cached" acts like a &bLocked Recipe&r: the machine will only run the recipe when the Pattern Buffer matches the previously cached operating conditions (including &bcatalysts&r, &bProgrammed Circuits&r, etc.), while also reducing the performance cost of recipe lookups
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: “配方已缓存”相当于某种&b锁定配方&r，只有当样板总成符合之前缓存的运行条件（包括&b催化剂&r，&b编程电路&r等）时才会让机器运行配方，同时降低机器搜索配方的性能消耗

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: Supports caching multiple recipes within the same pattern (requires setting the Actual number of recipes in the dedicated Catalyst Tank GUI)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 支持在同一个样板中缓存多个配方（需在专用催化剂槽的GUI中设置实际配方数量）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: In the ME Pattern Manager Terminal and pattern upload screen, the default name of a Pattern Buffer is the name of its multiblock controller followed by its Programmed Circuit number (e.g., Mega Blast Smelter - 3)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 在ME样板管理终端以及样板上传界面中样板总成的默认名称为所在多方块主机名字以及加上设置的编程电路（如超级冶炼炉-3）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: The dedicated Catalyst Tank GUI can be dragged around (though minor visual overlap glitches may occur)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 专用催化剂槽的GUI可以拖动（可能会有奇怪的覆盖显示问题）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: If Middle-Click fails to open the dedicated Catalyst Tank, check whether Middle-Click is bound to a conflicting keybind such as inventory sorting
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 如果中键无法打开专用催化剂槽，检查中键是否绑定了其他可能冲突的功能，比如背包整理

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: Pattern Buffers force AE to &bignore&r &cbyproducts&r in patterns during crafting calculations; this can be toggled off in the bottom-left corner of the GUI
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 样板总成会强行让AE在合成时&b忽视&r样板中的&c副产物&r，可在GUI左下角关闭

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: The Configuration Copy Tool &6cannot&r copy catalyst settings; make sure you have enough &dBlank Patterns&r in your inventory when pasting settings
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 复制工具&6不能&r复制催化剂设置；黏贴配置时请确保背包内有足够的&d空白样板&r

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: The Cut Tool &6can&r move catalyst settings
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.zh: 剪切工具&6可以&r搬运催化剂设置

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.688861674cac5315.en: Also counts as an ME hatch

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68a3d32bff9bf7f3.en: Can be made using Indium Phosphide or Quantum Eyes
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68a3d32bff9bf7f3.zh: 可以用磷化铟，也可以用量子之眼

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68d3e6670941a3f5.en: Vein Essences are not only used for the precision mode of the Large Void Miner, but are also an ingredient for mandatory items later on
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68d3e6670941a3f5.zh: 各种矿脉精华不仅用于大型虚空采矿场的精准模式，还是后续必需物品的材料之一

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68d3e6670941a3f5.en: Essences can only be crafted using &9GregTech&r Milk; to get it, milk a cow with a bucket, put it into an Extractor, and then craft a Cow Spawn Egg for infinite extraction
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.68d3e6670941a3f5.zh: 精华只能使用&9GregTech&r的牛奶制作，牛奶又怎么来呢，舀一桶牛奶之后放到提取机里面，然后合成牛刷怪蛋无限提取

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6a6895119cecf238.en: Uses electricity directly for implosion—no explosives required—and can even equip a Parallel Control Hatch!
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6a6895119cecf238.zh: 使用电力直接聚爆，不再需要炸药，还能安装并行控制仓！

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6a6895119cecf238.en: Can only use a &eLuV&r Muffler Hatch
You can craft the Extreme Crafting Table now, though it is practically useless
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6a6895119cecf238.zh: 你现在可以制作终极工作台了，但几乎没有用处

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6c24e5ba18fe8cf5.en: No need to lay Optical Pipes anymore

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6c4f1c87f08f38ac.en: Since UV Wireless Energy Hatches require Neutronium, try attaching your highest-tier Wireless Energy Cover to a freshly crafted Machine Hull, then point the Machine Hull at the Energy Hatch on the Fusion Reactor (red face to green dot)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6c4f1c87f08f38ac.zh: 由于UV无线能源仓需要中子素，试试将现有最大无线能源覆盖板贴到刚做的机器外壳上，然后把机器外壳对准聚变堆上的能源仓（红对绿）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6c4f1c87f08f38ac.en: You can also use an Active Transformer—placing a Dynamo Hatch directly against an Energy Hatch transfers power too
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6c4f1c87f08f38ac.zh: 也可以用有源变压器，动力仓和能源仓紧贴也能传电

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.en: Can be shared across multiple Resource Collection Modules using &dME Stocking Input Buses / Dual Input Hatches&r
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.zh: 可以用&dME库存总线/成&r给多台采集模块共用

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.en: Once you have Infused Gold Dust, remember to upgrade to Power Module MK2!
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.zh: 有了注魔金粉后，记得升级动力模块MK2！

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.en: The numbers in the subtitle indicate the corresponding Programmed Circuit numbers
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.zh: 副标题里的数字代表对应的电路

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6d83baac7db34d51.en: Meteorite (6), Rubidium (7), Alien Algae (14), Ancient Debris (17), Infused Gold (20), Titanium (21), Tellurium (23), Tungsten (23), Trinium Compound (24), Enriched Naquadah (24), Indium (24)

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6dde77c23fc5d067.en: Optional; the Space Elevator can also mine all the unmineable ores produced by the Large Void Miner
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.6dde77c23fc5d067.zh: 不是必须的，太空电梯也可以挖到所有大型虚空采矿厂产出的无法采掘的矿物

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.71d029b59c690121.en: The second machine capable of condensing plasma
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.71d029b59c690121.zh: 第二台可以冷凝等离子体的机器

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.7204f1b6bcc74f1c.en: UHV requires a large amount of Netherite

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: Simply put, the hatch pulls items from the ME Network into its own internal inventory for the machine to use (essentially acting like an ME Interface)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: 简单来说就是仓室从ME网络抽物品到它自己的内部储存，然后再让机器使用它的内部储存物品（其实就是ME接口）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: The &6pull limit&r of ME Input Buses/Hatches has been buffed to &b9.2E/P
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: ME输入总线/仓的&6拉取上限&r加强至&b9.2E/P

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: Left-click with a &dData Stick&r to save hatch settings, and Right-Click to apply them
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: 用&d闪存&r左键保存仓室配置，右键应用配置

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: Right-click an ME hatch with &dWire Cutters&r to toggle between connecting to the ME Network only from the front face or from any face
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: 用&d剪线钳&r右键ME仓室可以让ME仓室在从正面联网和从任意面联网之间切换

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: You can adjust the &6pull interval&r in the bottom-left corner of the hatch GUI; the default 0tick leaves the interval unchanged, with a &bminimum of 1tick&r (affecting how fast it pulls from the ME Network)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: 可在仓室gui左下角调整&6拉取间隔&r，默认显示0tick为不改变拉取间隔，&b最低1tick&r（影响从ME网络拉取的速度）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: All three ME output hatches feature long-scale capacity and infinite slots (exporting once per second, with a single machine output acceptance limit of &bint&r)
gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.zh: 三种ME输出仓室均拥有long级别的容量和无限的格子（每秒输出一次，单次接受机器输出量上限为&bint&r）

gtlcore.quest.gtl.quest.733741c26c6bf5c3.en: The ME Dual Output Hatch has been optimized for better performance, and can &6manually&r eject items/fluids retained inside it back into the ME Network
